$description: GymOS design tokens, option "Floodlight" (recommended, status: proposed). Generated by scripts/tokens-build.mjs on 2026-11-23. Aliases use DTCG {path} syntax; $extensions.resolved carries the hex.

hairline.$description: web 1px; native StyleSheet.hairlineWidth for separators only

focus.$description: focus ring, drawn with a 2px offset

card.$description: light only; dark uses surface steps + border; iOS uses hairline separators, no card shadow

ui.$description: Google Fonts, OFL. Axes opsz 14-32, wght 100-900. Features in the Google build: tnum, pnum, frac, calt (no cv/ss sets).

display.$description: Google Fonts, OFL, Omnibus-Type. Axes wdth 62-125, wght 100-900. Has tnum. Native: bundle static instances (wdth 112 and 125 at wght 700) fetched from the Google Fonts API.

urduReading.$description: Google Fonts, OFL. wght 400-700. hhea ascent+descent = 2.50 em.

urduUi.$description: Google Fonts, OFL. wght 400-700. hhea ascent+descent = 1.70 em.

chrome.$description: Nav bar, tab bar, client header. Carries fg.primary text and icons only.

sheet.$description: Sheets and overlays that carry secondary text, links or inputs.

fallback.$description: Solid fill when Reduce Transparency, high contrast, no backdrop-filter, or Android below API 31.

chrome.$description: Nav bar, tab bar, client header. Carries fg.primary text and icons only.

sheet.$description: Sheets and overlays that carry secondary text, links or inputs.

fallback.$description: Solid fill when Reduce Transparency, high contrast, no backdrop-filter, or Android below API 31.

component.$description: Component references like {action.bg} are relative to semantic.<mode>.color, so one component definition serves light, dark and glass. {primitive.*} paths are absolute.

disabled.note: Never pre-disable a submit; validate on press instead.

severeAllergy.rule: The only solid red chip in the system. Never tenant-coloured, never glass, always visible on task screens where food is edited.

tabBar.rule: unselected labels use fg.primary at weight 500, never fg.secondary, so they stay legible on glass

typography.$description: Roles, not sizes. Each role lists web desktop, web phone (<768px), iOS text style (Dynamic Type) and Android type role (sp). Numbers always tabular (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums / fontVariant ['tabular-nums']).

displayTitle.ios: title1 28/34 (in-content only; native nav bars keep the system font)

ur.sizeDelta: +1px desktop, +2px phone (Arabic-script x-height reads smaller at the same em)
ur.note: Start values. Verify with real strings on Android, where Nastaliq first-line clipping is a reported problem.

tenant.$description: Per-tenant input and what the app derives from it at runtime.

input.brand.primary: hex, required, validated at the manifest boundary (throws on invalid)
input.radius: crisp | soft | round (soft = radius tokens above)

derived: action.bg (exact brand when its label reaches 4.5:1, else darkened in OKLCH at the same hue)
action.fg (white or ink, whichever contrasts more)
action.text per mode (>= 4.5:1 on surface and canvas)
tenant.collisionPolicy: If the brand's Oklab Delta E to status.danger.solid is under 15 (normal vision), filled actions switch to the inverse neutral (bg.inverse fill, fg.inverse label), links and focus use fg.primary, selection washes use bg.hover, and the brand stays on the logo and app icon. Warning/success closeness and CVD closeness are reported to the tenant admin as advisory.
